extraction.name: MTEB: Massive Text Embedding Benchmark
extraction.description: MTEB spans 8 embedding tasks covering a total of 58 datasets and 112 languages.
extraction.creator: Niklas Muennighoff, Nouamane Tazi, Loïc Magne, Nils Reimers
extraction.rai:dataCollection: MTEB unifies datasets from different embedding tasks into a common, accessible evaluation framework.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: MTEB incorporates SemEval datasets (STS11 - STS22) and BEIR alongside a variety of other datasets from various tasks
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Through versioning at a dataset and software level, we aim to make it easy to reproduce results in MTEB.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: MTEB covers multiple text lengths (S2S, P2P, S2P), but very long documents are still missing.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The Massive Text Embedding Benchmark (MTEB) aims to provide clarity on how models perform on a variety of embedding tasks and thus serves as the gateway to finding universal text embeddings applicable to a variety of tasks.

description.evidence: MTEB spans 8 embedding tasks covering a total of 58 datasets and 112 languages.

isLiveDataset.evidence: We welcome dataset, task or metric contributions from the community via pull requests to continue the development of MTEB.

rai:dataCollection.evidence: MTEB unifies datasets from different embedding tasks into a common, accessible evaluation framework. MTEB incorporates SemEval datasets (STS11 - STS22) and BEIR alongside a variety of other datasets from various tasks to provide a holistic performance review of text embedding models.

rai:dataCollectionType.evidence: MTEB incorporates SemEval datasets (STS11 - STS22) and BEIR alongside a variety of other datasets from various tasks to provide a holistic performance review of text embedding models.

rai:dataCollectionRawData.evidence: MTEB incorporates SemEval datasets (STS11 - STS22) and BEIR alongside a variety of other datasets from various tasks to provide a holistic performance review of text embedding models.

rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan.evidence: Through versioning at a dataset and software level, we aim to make it easy to reproduce results in MTEB.

rai:dataLimitations.evidence: MTEB covers multiple text lengths (S2S, P2P, S2P), but very long documents are still missing. The longest datasets in MTEB have a few hundred words, and longer text sizes could be relevant for use cases like retrieval.

rai:dataUseCases.evidence: The Massive Text Embedding Benchmark (MTEB) aims to provide clarity on how models perform on a variety of embedding tasks and thus serves as the gateway to finding universal text embeddings applicable to a variety of tasks.
